headline: هل يتبع مساعد الذكاء الاصطناعي دليل الشركة؟ اختبار 65 مهمة مهنية
reviewer: AI editorial simulation (not a human reader test)
summary: اختبر الباحثون مساعدين على 65 مهمة تحكمها أدلة شركة طويلة. نجح أفضل إعداد في 94 من 260 محاولة فقط، وكشفت المسارات أن إيجاد القاعدة لا يضمن تطبيقها.
mobile_evidence: GitHub Arabic editorial gate run 40928632067 rendered the candidate at actual Chromium mobile widths; no overflow was detected. Live desktop Chromium also reported scrollWidth equal to clientWidth.

source_evidence.claim: 65 tasks, ten fictional companies, five domains, unique 20–124 page handbooks
source_evidence.assessment: Controlled simulation, not live enterprise deployment

source_evidence.claim: 824 deterministic criteria split 592/824 expected-output and 232/824 incorrect-behavior
source_evidence.assessment: Programmatic final-state checks; no LLM judge

source_evidence.claim: 65 tasks × four trials = 260 outcomes per configuration; leader 36.2%
source_evidence.assessment: 94/260 pass and 166/260 fail are arithmetic reconstructions from rounded percentage
Qualitative examples; no prevalence denominator for each pattern

source_evidence.claim: 86 deployment practitioners, 20 cases, 68% step limit and 74% human evaluation
source_evidence.assessment: Independent side context; source-reported rounded percentages

decision: PASS — editorial, evidence, bilingual parity, mobile rendering and live-page verification complete; exact-head completion checks remain tracked in the publication checkpoint.
terminology_evidence: AI agent, standing instruction, SOP, strict pass@1, deterministic criterion and medical billing are defined.
language_evidence: Problem-first Arabic passed a 20–30 second simulation; all reconstructable percentages carry numerator and denominator.

live_evidence.specialist_hubs: one card per language; 1200×630 cover loaded
